newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND LITTLE CHANGED VS DLR, LOW DLR DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND LITTLE CHANGED VS DLR, LOW DLR DEMAND.

text.p: The Egyptian pound remained almost unchanged against the dollar on Thursday in a private sector market still liquid in with the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is very quiet. There's very little demand for the dollar," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar between 3.3890 and 3.3925 bid and 3.3910 and 3.3950 pounds offered.
The average rate was 3.390625 bid and 3.3930 offered compared to 3.3905 bid and 3.3925 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The central bank calculated the average rate at midday at 3.387970 pounds buy and 3.394169 pounds sell.
